description: This file defines a static class 'TableFormatter' with methods for manipulating and formatting tables within the MigraDoc document object model, including expanding tables, setting rounded corners, adjusting outer cell sizes, copying shading, removing borders, inserting glue columns, and surrounding content with tables.

classes.name: TableFormatter
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods for table formatting and manipulation within MigraDoc.

methods.name: ExpandTable
methods.description: Expands the table by adding rows and columns around its perimeter based on specified counts.

methods.name: SetRoundedCorners
methods.description: Sets the corner cells of the table to have rounded corners.

methods.name: SetOuterCellsWidth
methods.description: Sets the width of outer columns and height of outer rows to specified units.

methods.name: CopyNeighboringRowShadingToTop
methods.description: Copies shading from a specific row to the rows above.

methods.name: CopyNeighboringRowShadingToBottom
methods.description: Copies shading from a specific row to the rows below.

methods.name: RemoveInnerHorizontalBorders
methods.description: Removes inner horizontal borders between specified rows.

methods.name: RemoveInnerVerticalBorders
methods.description: Removes inner vertical borders between specified columns.

methods.name: InsertGlueColumn
methods.description: Inserts a 'glue' column to prevent page breaks at specific table regions.

methods.name: SurroundContentWithTable
methods.description: Wraps specified content elements with a one-column table, replacing the original elements.
